name: masterfx
description: Master reverb and delay per project: Config > Project Settings > Master FX > Reverb chooses Stock (default), Freeverb (public domain), Plate (Dattorro), Spring or Shimmer, and Delay chooses Stock (default), Tape (a tape echo), BBD (an analog bucket-brigade delay) or "Gated" (a gated reverb burst), for each project; the Master Reverb and Master Delay knobs drive them

branches.note: Config menu constructor: Project Settings folder, room for one more item
Config menu constructor: last item (Licenses); then adds the Master FX folder (Reverb, Delay) to Project Settings, and puts the reverb and delay back to stock until the Pattern screen runs
save request 0x60114e34, Save As only: bl strncpy(fm+0x340, name, 0x21) -> mt_mfx_save_name (the choices go with the project to its new name)

words.note: master reverb object vtable: update method 0x60031e5d -> mt_mfx_reverb_update (the project's reverb: stock, Freeverb, Plate, Spring or Shimmer)
master delay object vtable: update method 0x60032405 -> mt_mfx_delay_update (the project's delay: stock, Tape, BBD or "Gated")
Pattern screen vtable: update method 0x600e1f99 -> mt_mfx_pattern_update (settings file load/save; the unit has booted)
Config screen vtable: update method 0x600c6475 -> mt_mfx_config_update (settings file load/save)
